applies_to: coreav decode-audio outputs of MP4 inputs with an edit list, through scripts/decode_audio_check.py and ffmpeg 7.0.2 (its default decode, edits applied, against CoreAV's presentation timeline)

conditions.raw edit list: an empty edit (media_time -1) before the first media edit that presents a sample
conditions.CoreAV's samples for it: silence (zeros), its length the edit's duration

entries.basis: ISO/IEC 14496-12 8.6.6 (an empty edit is a time with no media presented); docs/design/audio-decode.md, Edit lists (silence for every empty edit, a leading one included)

fields: the samples after a media edit's end

conditions.raw edit list: a media edit whose end, in samples, falls inside a packet before the end of the media
conditions.ffmpeg's output: the edit's window followed by the rest of that packet, the packet's own samples of ffmpeg's full decode

entries.basis: ISO/IEC 14496-12 8.6.6 (a media edit presents segment_duration of media from media_time); docs/design/audio-decode.md, Edit lists (windows cut sample-exact at both ends)

fields: the first samples of a media edit after the first

conditions.raw edit list: a media edit after one that presented samples, whose media_time, in samples, falls inside a packet
conditions.CoreAV's samples for it: the media's samples from media_time to the next packet's start
conditions.ffmpeg's output: the edit from the next packet's start

entries.basis: ISO/IEC 14496-12 8.6.6; docs/design/audio-decode.md, Edit lists (windows cut sample-exact at both ends)

fields: the samples of an empty edit after a media edit

conditions.raw edit list: an empty edit after a media edit that presented samples
conditions.CoreAV's samples for it: silence (zeros), its length the edit's duration
conditions.ffmpeg's output: in their place the media's first whole packets, those starting before the edit's length, as ffmpeg's full decode has them (for a lossy codec the first of those packets in length only: its decoder state carries over from the packet before)

entries.basis: ISO/IEC 14496-12 8.6.6 (an empty edit is a time with no media presented); docs/design/audio-decode.md, Edit lists
